title: OpenSearch

opensearch.host.title: Host
opensearch.host.description: URL of the OpenSearch server e.g. http://localhost:9200

opensearch.collection.title: Collection
opensearch.collection.description: The name of the collection to use for the OpenSearch index. Only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores are allowed.

opensearch.dim.title: Embedding Dimension
opensearch.dim.description: Dimension of the embedding vectors stored in the index.

opensearch.score.title: Retrieval Score
opensearch.score.description: Minimum retrieval score for vector stores

opensearch.search.title: Customize Indexing Search Behavior
opensearch.search.description: Customize the search behavior of the index with the options below. This option does not affect the ingestion and creation of the index. You can switch between behaviors when searching between pipeline runs.

opensearch.matchOperator.title: Match Operator
description: Controls how multiple query terms are matched:
'or' (default) matches documents containing ANY of the query terms,
'and' matches documents containing ALL of the query terms,
'exact' requires the exact phrase to appear in order (phrase matching).

opensearch.slop.title: Slop
opensearch.slop.description: The number of words to allow between terms when exact phrase search is enabled.

opensearch.highlight.title: Return contextual snippets
opensearch.highlight.description: Use the unified highlighter to return snippets around matches.

opensearch.fragment_size.title: Snippet size (characters)
opensearch.fragment_size.description: Maximum characters in the returned highlight snippet (context window) per hit.

properties.name: auth
properties.title: Authentication
properties.description: How the node signs in to the server. With basic authentication the host is reached over HTTPS.

properties.name: mode
properties.title: Store Mode
properties.description: Index (BM25 text search) or vector store (semantic search over embeddings). Pick it before the first ingest: the index mapping differs between the two.

description: An OpenSearch node that supports classic BM25 search and vector search
for ingestion and retrieval workflows. Works with self-managed OpenSearch.
